About Event

Writofest is ScriptInk’s annual literary and creative event, providing a platform for writers, poets, storytellers, and performers to showcase their talent and share their ideas.

The event features writing competitions, open mic sessions, interactive activities, and inspiring literary sessions, encouraging participants to explore creativity, develop their expression, and connect through the power of words.

Registration FAQ

Is registration free for all students?

Please check the latest event announcement for registration details.

Will certificates be provided?

Certificates are provided according to the event participation and winner categories.

Can I participate in multiple events?

Participation depends on the event rules announced by ScriptInk.

Do they provide attendance?

Attendance information will be communicated by the organizers.

Will Event organizers provide food?

NO !, food will not be provided.

What are the prerequisites required for the event?

Follow the registration instructions and event-specific guidelines shared by ScriptInk.

Is it mandatory to follow the official insta page '@scriptink_official'?

YES !, It's mandatory to follow the official page for updates and winning the prize.
